model_annotation: The chart illustrates “effect” values across language-family categories for six model/setting combinations, shown as grouped bars with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the categories (left to right: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic), with the axis label “family.” The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 10, 20, and 30, spanning roughly from about −5 up to about 35. Within each family group there are six adjacent bars in a consistent order matching the legend at the right: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (darker blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (darker green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (red/pink), each with a vertical gray error bar and capped ends. Approximate bar heights by family are: IE-Baltic shows small positive values (mBERT-L₂ ~2, XLM-L₂ ~1–2, mBERT-R₂ ~3, XLM-R₂ ~3, mBERT-B₂ ~6, XLM-B₂ ~5); IE-Germanic shows mid values for L₂ and B₂ with R₂ near/below zero (mBERT-L₂ ~10, XLM-L₂ ~10, mBERT-R₂ ~0 to −1, XLM-R₂ ~−1 to −2, mBERT-B₂ ~15, XLM-B₂ ~15); IE-Indic shows near-zero L₂, larger R₂, and the largest B₂ bars (mBERT-L₂ ~1, XLM-L₂ ~0, mBERT-R₂ ~20, XLM-R₂ ~18, mBERT-B₂ ~24, XLM-B₂ ~21); IE-Romance shows moderate L₂ and R₂ with higher mBERT-B₂ (mBERT-L₂ ~6, XLM-L₂ ~4, mBERT-R₂ ~5, XLM-R₂ ~1, mBERT-B₂ ~12–13, XLM-B₂ ~5–6); IE-Slavic shows L₂ around ~9–11, small R₂ near ~0–1, and B₂ around ~15–17 (mBERT-L₂ ~10–11, XLM-L₂ ~9, mBERT-R₂ ~1, XLM-R₂ ~0–1, mBERT-B₂ ~17, XLM-B₂ ~15–16); IE-other shows L₂ around ~5–6, R₂ near zero, and B₂ around ~8 (mBERT-L₂ ~6, XLM-L₂ ~6, mBERT-R₂ ~0–1, XLM-R₂ ~0, mBERT-B₂ ~8, XLM-B₂ ~8); Isolate shows values clustered near zero to ~2 (mBERT-L₂ ~0, XLM-L₂ ~0, mBERT-R₂ ~1–2, XLM-R₂ ~1, mBERT-B₂ ~2, XLM-B₂ ~1–2); Semitic shows L₂ and B₂ in the low-to-high teens with negative R₂ bars (mBERT-L₂ ~11, XLM-L₂ ~16, mBERT-R₂ ~−2, XLM-R₂ ~−3, mBERT-B₂ ~15, XLM-B₂ ~19–20); and Uralic shows all bars close to zero with a small positive mBERT-B₂ (most series ~0–1, mBERT-B₂ ~2). The categories are not displayed in an obvious sorted-by-value order, and no bars appear specially highlighted beyond the consistent color coding and the presence of error bars.
